about_the_game:
Step into the mysterious world of truth! In this 2D truth-building role-playing game, you will play as a seeker who is eager to achieve enlightenment for a long time, and start a journey full of challenges and opportunities.

Core Gameplay:

Brave the Tower of Babel and gather the spirit of heaven and earth: deep into the tower of treacherous, mountainous trials. Each layer is an unknown secret, hidden rare materials, rare animals and ancient ruins. Use your wits and skills to fight, explore, and collect the core materials for the Elixir and magic weapon.

Danding refining mystery, the device into the world: find Lingcao Xian mine, concentrate on alchemy and refining method. Mix Danfang with your own hands to make a variety of elixis with different effects -- instantly restoring spiritual power, permanently elevating the root and bone, or stimulating the potential to burst into divine power. Can also forge a unique magic weapon - flying sword to kill the enemy in the air, treasure shield to protect the body comprehensive, the wonderful use of infinite. Your choice determines your path to truth.

Explore the supreme Law, divine power from heaven: In the exploration and challenge, find scattered in the world of ancient magic secrets and practice. Each realization will make your strength a qualitative leap.

Fierce battle against the enemy, asked the peak: the road to repair the truth is not smooth! You will encounter fierce and furious monsters, evil repair, and even guarding the tower of the ancient giants. The use of carefully refined dan-medicine magic weapon, with the learned magic, in the rapidly changing battle strategy victory, challenge more and more powerful enemy, step by step to the tower, to the supreme way forward!

Features of the game:

Authentic Xizhen experience: immerse yourself in a carefully drawn 2D fairy style world and feel a strong Oriental fantasy atmosphere.

Rich collection and manufacture: massive materials, various Danfang, unique magic formula, to meet your desire to collect and creativity.

Deep character growth: through alchemy, refining, learning secrets, fighting strong enemies, all-round improvement of character strength, experience the joy of realm breakthrough.

Strategic Combat: Combine your abilities, powers, potions, and skill sets to deal with different combat challenges.

Step by Step challenge: The design of the tower of trials is progressive, bringing a continuous sense of conquest and achievement.

Prepare your heart, collect spiritual materials, refine divine soldiers, understand metaphysical skills, and meet strong enemies. On this road of truth cultivation full of hardships and adventures, write your immortal legend! ​

content_descriptors.notes: The game does not include graphic violence or images related to death, but some scenes may contain sexual innuendo, and all characters have no exposed sensitive parts.
